reason: A dsh Web GUI plugin for copying an idle session, including its conversation history, context, agent preset, and model selection, into another workspace with an option to archive the original.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh Web GUI 中将空闲会话及其完整上下文迁移或复制到其他工作区，并可选择归档原会话。
summaries.en: Moves or copies an idle dsh Web GUI session with its full context to another workspace, with an option to archive the original session.

capabilities: Copies complete session logs and metadata to another workspace
Creates a new session record and attaches it to the target workspace
Adds session migration controls to the web interface
